title: EquipmentShare Plans to Expand in Las Cruces
summary: EquipmentShare announced plans to expand its operations in Southern New Mexico with a new facility in Las Cruces.
body_markdown:
**LAS CRUCES, N.M. — \[Oct. 6, 2026\]** — EquipmentShare.com Inc. (Nasdaq: EQPT) (EquipmentShare), a leader in connected jobsite technology and one of the largest construction equipment rental providers in the United States, today announced plans to expand its operations in Southern New Mexico with a new facility in Las Cruces. Located at 9030 Advancement Ave. in the Las Cruces Innovation & Industrial Park, the planned site will feature a Site Solutions managed services operation designed to strengthen equipment and jobsite service availability for contractors throughout Doña Ana County and the broader Borderplex region.


The upcoming Las Cruces facility will deliver EquipmentShare's Site Solutions managed jobsite services, including mobile tool trailers, on-site fueling, equipment management, and specialized jobsite support. A typical EquipmentShare location is associated with the creation of 25 to 50 local jobs, ranging from service technicians and logistics specialists to CDL drivers.


By expanding its physical branch footprint into Southern New Mexico, EquipmentShare ensures that contractors have direct access to modern tools, reliable fleets, and connectivity solutions required to keep complex infrastructure and commercial projects moving efficiently.


"EquipmentShare's decision to expand in Las Cruces is another example of the momentum our community continues to build. This planned investment is expected to create quality jobs and strengthen our industrial economy. They also reinforce why companies continue to choose Las Cruces as a place to invest and grow," stated City of Las Cruces Mayor Eric Enriquez.


The location will utilize EquipmentShare's proprietary operating system,[T3®](https://t3.tech/) , connecting customers to real-time fleet management, telematics tracking, jobsite monitoring, and automated productivity tools.


EquipmentShare is expected to begin initial operations at the Las Cruces facility later this year.


**About EquipmentShare**


Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Columbia, Missouri, EquipmentShare (Nasdaq: EQPT) is a nationwide construction technology and equipment solutions provider dedicated to transforming the construction industry through innovative tools, platforms, and data-driven insights. By empowering contractors, builders, and equipment owners with its proprietary technology, T3®, EquipmentShare aims to drive productivity, efficiency, and collaboration across the construction sector. With a comprehensive suite of solutions that includes a fleet management platform, telematics devices, and a best-in-class equipment rental marketplace, EquipmentShare continues to lead the industry in building the future of construction. For more information, visit[www.equipmentshare.com](http://www.equipmentshare.com/) .
